notes.title: THE BIGGEST UPDATE YET: STORY MODE
notes.content:
Story mode is almost complete, but keep in mind that everything is subject to change based on feedback, which can be sent to the discord server! 

A non exhaustive list of what has been added:

-Several 'story levels' that occur on certain nights, allowing you to explore and investigate the mysteries of your surroundings. 

-A massive amount of art and music created for these story levels. 5 new songs and over 15 digital paintings.

- A terrifying new enemy that will show up late in the game.

-a veritable mountain of bug fixes and performance improvements.

- several gameplay tweaks to balance some of the upgrades and playstyles.

- new sound FX have been added, as well as other special FX like screen shake, particle FX, and adaptive lighting!

GamePlay changes

- Knockback given to enemies is now directional, meaning that the enemy will fly away at an angle measured from the queen, instead of just moving backwards. this also applies to the food they drop!
(NOTE: please be careful not to launch dragonflies directly into the nest, that would not be good)



Balance changes

- Good Investm-ants upgrade has been toned down to make it less "necessary" for late game play. to compensate, it has been made cheaper.

-ants cost slightly less to hatch

-ant stats scale slightly faster when upgrading, especially their movement speed. 

- Queen base damage has been increased

- enemy spawns have been adjusted for more variety

- dropped food is now up to 3 times bigger if the enemy dies near the edge of the screen

- base amount of food dropped has been increased.

- Game now starts with 0 ants instead of the usual 5.

- explosive waves now propagate lightning fast, it might be broken, but it sure is fun.

- many, many others. 

as with any large update, there are bound to be glaring bugs, typos, crashes, and other unpleasant things. please be patient and make sure to report any bugs you find so that they can be fixed quickly! 

HAVE FUN!

notes.title: Now You Can Send Your Feedback To The OFFICIAL DISCORD!
notes.content:
The more feedback I get, the better the game will be. So send as much as you'd like! It is extremely helpful. 


You can join the server by selecting the "Send Feedback" button found in the main menu, 


or clicking here

Things you are encouraged to send:


 - any bugs you encounter, give as much detail as you can.
 - screenshots of any weird behavior
 - gameplay elements you find fun, or frustrating.
 - suggestions for improvements to the game
 - terrible ant puns


Things you should probably not send:

 - any hate speech or symbols
 - any language generally inappropriate for civil discussion
 - links or files that require downloads
 - anything off topic, IE: unrelated to Queen Of The Hill

notes.title: MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004789/e8acca5debf16e00848f6e618723e18f96b7225c.png

the incredibly handsome developer has introduced a new set of substantial improvements to Queen Of The Hill. including but not limited to:

Technical changes:

-UI has now been simplified and polished up with our new "dashboard style" interface. complete with bright colors and Blinky dials

-Game now scales properly with different screen resolutions

- cooldowns for adding food and removing obstacles are now shown on the left of the screen.

-overhauling the rendering pipeline has skyrocketed performance. on our tests we saw a consistent 200fps at 1440p. fps is hard capped at 160 in this build however.

Gameplay Changes:
- Queen now has a short cooldown on her bites to prevent attack spam.
- new attack speed upgrade has been implemented and can improve this cooldown
- enemies now drop up to 2x the normal amount of food if they are killed near the edges of the screen
- enemies now drop up to 30% less food than usual when killed close to the nest
- Knockback upgrades now scale more linearly to prevent launching enemies into orbit. (though it was funny)
- Ants now all receive an upgrade when an upgrade is purchased as opposed to only ants hatched post upgrade
- Enemies now spawn in more cohesive groups instead of randomly
- purple skulls spawn rates have been lowered to curb the amount of rocks on the screen.
- Several upgrades have had their prices altered to reflect the results of the playtesting

Bug Fixes
- a lot. a loooooooot.
- Queen attack animation speed stays consistent across framerates.
- ants pathfinding has been improved and they are less likely to get "stuck" near fruit
- Enemies now behave consistently when getting knocked back
- Enemies now drop more appropriate amount of food
- removed herobrine.
